strategyReview: The Polymarket NO/YES-fade edge remains the strongest part of the book: live one-touch NO is 4/4 with +18.42% avg, USER_PM_IV_TOUCH_RICH_NO is 2/3 with huge contract P&L, and the weekend funding family is 393/567 live with shadows 188/253. The bleeding is concentrated in proxy-short expressions and in forcing contract-priced edge into spot-move tests; single-name weekend funding reverts and HYPE-confirmation momentum are also failing, mostly because their triggering conditions do not reliably produce the predicted move.

failureClusters.recommendation: Do not route contract-pricing edge through spot/proxy shorts; re-express as contract premium fades or stop spending budget on this expression.

failureClusters.evidence: MU 7/19 37%, CBRS 14/31 45%, AAPL 12/24 50%; losing examples show funding oscillating or extending lower rather than normalizing within 2 days.
failureClusters.recommendation: Require a relative extreme plus a 24h upward inflection before funding-reversion entries, or pause these single-name weekend variants.

failureClusters.theme: Contract premium fade scored as spot decline
failureClusters.evidence: H-534 has 8/23 wins and 7 unscorable tests; contract outcomes such as NO GOLD below 4300 +5.3% win, while the authored spot-decline prediction is why variants were unscorable or failed.
failureClusters.recommendation: Re-author one-touch NO edge explicitly as neutral contract P&L with expiry and spread guards, never as a 2% spot move.

failureClusters.theme: HYPE risk-on confirmation as BTC timing
failureClusters.evidence: cross_asset_iv_compression_vol_expansion is 9/25 36% across many near-duplicate H-variants; examples include BTC -3.47% despite above-SMA BTC and HYPE risk-on conditions.
failureClusters.recommendation: Stop refining HYPE-confirmation as a BTC momentum timing signal; treat the mechanism as invalid.

failureClusters.theme: BTC PM IV compression forced into absolute spot move
failureClusters.evidence: btc_iv_compression_vol_reversion is 3/14 21%; zscore < -1.5 often produces moves like 1.22% and -1.24%, below the >2% bar.
failureClusters.recommendation: Drop the 2% absolute-spot formulation or rewrite as a contract/vol thesis rather than a directional mover.

hypothesisReviews.observation: The raw single-threshold CBRS entry fails because deeply negative funding often continues lower or oscillates instead of normalizing within two days; examples show funding moving -4.3→-33.8 and -1.0→-98.5. The signal is a funding-squeeze marker, not an entry trigger.
hypothesisReviews.invalidatedAssumption: A single CBRS funding reading below -10% reliably normalizes within two days and forces a >2% CBRS spot gain.

hypothesisReviews.observation: AAPL funding below -10% does not predict a 2-day rebound; it often prints inert readings such as 5.5→5.5 or moves the wrong way like 2.7→-3.2. The threshold marks neither a reliable weekend effect nor a genuine overshoot extreme.
hypothesisReviews.invalidatedAssumption: A single AAPL funding reading below -10% on any day reliably normalizes and yields a >2% spot gain within 2 days.

hypothesisReviews.observation: MU funding below -10% is usually not the start of normalization; multiple losses show funding staying benign or collapsing further such as 5.5→-28.6. The original condition lacks any confirmation that the extreme is being repaired.
hypothesisReviews.invalidatedAssumption: A single MU funding reading below -10% reliably normalizes and produces a >2% spot gain within 2 days.

hypothesisReviews.observation: The 35% win rate is misleading because 7 tests cannot be scored; the examples that do score show the edge pays as contract NO premium, while the authored spot-decline prediction is what fails or becomes unscorable. The family was testing the wrong instrument.
hypothesisReviews.invalidatedAssumption: The gold one-touch high-edge NO signal pays via a >2% GOLD spot decline within 2 days, rather than via contract premium decay.

hypothesisReviews.observation: The cross-asset HYPE-confirmation setup has 9/25 wins across many near-duplicate variants and includes losses such as BTC -3.47% despite spot being above the 24h SMA and HYPE risk-on participation. HYPE acts as a late echo, not a reliable BTC confirmer.
hypothesisReviews.invalidatedAssumption: HYPE spot above its 24h SMA with stable OI is an independent confirmation of durable BTC upside rather than late-stage FOMO or overextension.

hypothesisReviews.observation: BTC PM IV z-score < -1.5 does not force a quick 2% snapback; the family is 3/14 with many examples under the bar such as 1.22% and -1.24%. Compression can persist longer than the 3-day window, so the absolute-move criterion is not being triggered.
hypothesisReviews.invalidatedAssumption: BTC PM IV below its 30-day mean by more than 1.5 standard deviations reliably leads to a >2% absolute spot move within 3 days.

journalEntry: Tonight's main lesson is instrumentation: contract-priced edge must be scored as contract P&L rather than forced into spot-move tests. The panel NO cut remains the strongest edge, so I added tighter near-dated, liquidity, and spread siblings from the ranked PANEL findings. I also re-authored the GOLD one-touch NO edge as a contract premium fade. Single-name funding reverts only merit another test with a relative extreme plus upward-inflection mechanism. No parameter changes: weekend-clustered and per-family evidence did not support moving entry or risk parameters.
